final_message:
I fixed the bug in `render_invoice` in `billing/render.py`. The "Amount due" line called `format_amount(currency, invoice["amount_due"])` with the arguments in the wrong order. I swapped them to `format_amount(invoice["amount_due"], currency)`.

The full suite now passes (25 tests), including your reproduction. I added that test as `tests/test_render_invoice.py`. I didn't run mypy.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root: `{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && grep -n "unsupported currency" *.py; cat render.py; ls

cd .. && sed -i 's/format_amount(currency, invoice\["amount_due"\])/format_amount(invoice["amount_due"], currency)/' billing/render.py && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

cd .. && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_render_invoice.py <<'EOF'
from billing.render import render_invoice


def test_render_invoice(world):
    from billing import tax

    tax.set_tax_rate(world.ctx, "US-CA", 825, "CA")
    cus = world.customer(region="US-CA")
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    text = render_invoice(world.ctx, inv)
    assert "Invoice INV-00001" in text
    assert "Tax (8.25%)" in text
    assert "$10.82" in text
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
